title: Panel scene
description: What one panel shows, as closed tags: panels.scene, written by Ai::Steps::Scene. Does not depend on the language: a translated episode copies it with its panels. The motion player (wave M, docs/motion-research.md) turns the tags into camera moves, weather effects and ambient sound by rules. New values may be added within a version (old tags stay valid); a new field or a removed or renamed value is a new version.

focus.description: Key of the character the camera moves to; null when nobody is in frame
